criteria.requirement: Add windowed_time(iterable,key,span) yielding a tuple of original events for each consumed event, inclusive interval [event_time-span,event_time]. Nondecreasing timestamp requirement, positive numeric/timedelta span, duplicates remain separate input-ordered events. Evict expired items before output, retain no full history, support sparse/empty/cross-day streams and propagate invalid order/arithmetic. Event time only, no clock or fake constant-memory claim when many events share span.
